2. Evaluation purpose 
The current evaluation is meant to be performed rig ht before completion of the Deployment 
Project (Number; 592486) - EU Aid Volunteers. The m ain objective of this evaluation is to 
assess to what extent the Deployment-EU Aid Volunte ers has contributed to achieve the 
expected results. The evaluation should also analys e the project implementation and the 
feasible sustainability. It is mainly concerned wit h assessing achieved impacts, identifying and 
judging unexpected impacts and verifying the sustai nability of the project's benefits in the 
framework of the MdM Consortium.  
The final product will be the conduct of the evaluation. 
For the evaluation the purpose is twofold, focusing  not only on the Project, but also on the 
Partnership performance throughout the implementation of the specific Project activities.  
The main users of these evaluations includes MdM Sp ain staff, such as project managers, 
operators in charge of the project conception, impl ementation, but also three MdM partners 
from the MdM Deployment project to whom accountabil ity is required in the framework of 
the Project.  
The MdM Consortium team hopes that these evaluation s may help to make improved 
decisions, to further articulate judgments on the d evelopment of future similar Deployment-
related activities, as well as to better understand the effects of the Projects. 
 
3. Specific objectives 
4.  As MdM participates as a Consortium in the EU Aid V olunteers Initiative, and MdM-
Spain as Head of Consortium, it is relevant for us to evaluate: The EU Aid Volunteers 
Initiative Deployment project implementation accord ing to the Project Logical 
framework, Work Plan and Budget and aligned with th e EU regulations and EU-MdM 
Grant Agreement. 
 
5.  Evaluate the MdM Deployment project Consortium mana gement process throughout 
the implementation of the Project, the external Con sultancies and aligned with the 
organization's volunteering policies. 
 
6.  Evaluate the MdM Deployment Consortium products and  effects produced by the 
project implementation.
